# Selection for improved flight performance

## Dry mass of adults

See Methods section for details of experimental set-up.

### Call relevant packages

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(AICcmodavg)
library(lmerTest)

theme_set(theme_cowplot())
```

### Import and wrangle data

Imported into a tibble "Mass_data_raw" and processed into "Mass_data"

```{r}
Mass_data_raw <- read_excel("DryMassData.xlsx", na = "NA")

Mass_data_raw <- Mass_data_raw %>% 
  mutate(DryMassTechnical = `DryMass(10e-4 g)`/BatchSize) %>% 
  drop_na()

Mass_data <- Mass_data_raw %>% group_by(Selection, PopReplicate, Vial, Sex, VialSample) %>% 
  summarise(DryMass = mean(DryMassTechnical)) %>% 
  mutate(PopRepNest = paste(Selection, PopReplicate, sep = "_")) %>% 
  mutate(VialNest = paste(PopRepNest, Vial, sep = "_V")) %>% 
  mutate_at(c("Selection", "PopReplicate", "PopRepNest", "Sex", "VialNest"), factor)
  
```

### Plots

```{r}
ggplot(data = Mass_data, aes(x = Selection, y = DryMass, shape = PopReplicate)) + geom_point( color = 'steelblue1', position = position_jitter(width = 0.1)) + facet_grid(~Sex) +
  stat_summary(fun = 'mean', color = 'red', size = 4, shape = '-')
```
